Cancellation Policy
For reservations involving 3 rooms or fewer:
If the cancellation is received by us:
– More than 30 days prior to arrival 100% of the deposit will be refunded.
– Between 29 and 14 days prior arrival 50% of the deposit will be refunded.
– Fewer than 14 days prior to arrival or for no shows, no refund on any payment will be made.
– For early check outs the full amount of the booking is payable.
For reservations involving 4 or more rooms:
For arrival dates on or between 15 May and 15 December (excluding 28 September to 7 October), if the cancellation is received by us:
– More than 60 days prior to arrival 100% of the deposit will be refunded
– Between 59 and 30 days prior arrival 50 % of the deposit will be refunded
– Fewer than 30 days prior to arrival or for no shows, no refund on any payment will be made
— For early check outs the full amount of the booking is payable.
For arrival dates on or between 16 December and 14 May & 28 September and 7 October (inclusive), if the cancellation is received by us:
– More than 90 days prior to arrival 100% of the deposit will be refunded
– Between 89 days and 60 days prior arrival 50% of the deposit will be refunded
– Fewer than 60 days prior to arrival or for no shows, no refund on any payment will be made.
– For early check outs the full amount of the booking is payable.
Partial Cancellation
For Group members the cancellation policy applies to each person. For example, if one group member cancels, their portion of the deposit will be non-refundable according to the refund policy above unless someone else can fill their space.
Administrative Fees
All requests for refunds will be subject to a reasonable administrative fee depending on the payment method used and the method of refund.
Pricing Policy and Surcharge Disclaimer
Please be advised that our pricing is established in good faith, based on current economic conditions and projected operational costs.
However, we operate in an industry highly sensitive to global market fluctuations and government fees and taxes. Significant shifts in world events—including, but not limited to, changes in fuel costs, tax regulations, or currency volatility and/or changes to local fees and charges can substantially impact our direct operational expenses.
Therefore, please note the following:
Price Adjustments: We reserve the right to adjust our rates or levy a surcharge to reflect significant increases in operating costs.
Confirmed Bookings: This policy applies to all reservations, including those already confirmed. Should a price adjustment become necessary, we will provide notice as soon as reasonably possible.
Commitment to Fairness: We remain committed to transparency and will only implement such measures when external economic factors leave us no viable alternative to maintain our safety and service standards.
By proceeding with your booking, you acknowledge and accept these terms regarding potential price fluctuations.
Third Party Agencies
These policies apply to direct bookings made through Mike’s Dauin Beach Resort. If you choose to book through a third party, different terms may apply please refer to the cancellation policy of your agency.
Travel Insurance
We do understand that sometimes cancellations unfortunately occur and we therefore urge you to seek appropriate travel insurance to cover the costs associated with unexpected events. In some cases we will consider a re-arrangement of dates subject to availability, the stay dates of the original booking and depending on individual circumstances.
Travel Documents
Please note that guests are responsible for obtaining the correct and valid travel documents that are required before arriving in the Philippines or to the Province of Negros Oriental, we cannot refund short-notice cancellations due to incorrect travel documents.
